Tick 300 is this rule's own step (decision 12): of the reading ladder from 100 to 2,000 ticks, the tick with the lowest loss of its own objective (projection-mmd at final against block-12002-pole-3x3) on that one picture. The winner fraction counts every patch; strength is the mean over those patches of u·c/m; winners use the strict original reader. The set is block-12002-pole-3x3.
